== Notes ==
* Consider using [[Mind Wrack]] in order to give you a visual cue when the target is out of energy while adding damage to the [[spike]].
* Can be extremely effective against [[Elementalist]]s due to the high energy total that [[Energy Storage]] can give them.
* Consider using this skill on newly [[Resurrection|resurrected]] foes, as they may have low energy and/or low [[health]].

{{anomaly|Aneurysm does not take [[overcast]] into account when calculating how much energy to generate; as such, it combines well with skills that force overcast (such as [[Arcane Languor]] or [[Exhausting Assault]]) as it will deal high damage without actually returning energy.}}

== Trivia ==
* An [[w:Aneurysm|aneurysm]] is a localized, blood-filled bulge in a blood vessel; they are most commonly found in the artery at the base of the brain.
